title: One-action mission pipeline planner and adaptive team launcher
summary: From one project request, Head proposes an editable milestone/task pipeline, maps work to eligible Color Teams, then a user action such as 'Work on this' launches one governed, evidence-verified sequential mission without re-prompting for ordinary internal handoffs.

origin.source: 2026-10-30 Color-Team-OPS Purple Team conversation: owner enjoyed the master issue/pipeline/task assignment workflow during v0.0.2 M5 and explicitly requested elaboration and capture as a new idea.

positive_effects: A single plain-language request becomes a visible, editable delivery plan with explicit tasks, dependencies, team assignments, acceptance gates and likely blockers.
The owner can review a complete plan and initiate the already-approved scope with one 'Work on this' action instead of writing a long meta prompt or manually switching teams.
Head dynamically reassigns subsequent tasks among the existing nine specialist teams, one at a time, with evidence-based Validate/Internal Auditor gates and bounded repairs.
Source-linked mission status and artifacts make work auditable and restartable rather than relying on chat-only claims.
negative_effects: A plan generator can invent requirements, dependencies or specialist competence; owner-facing draft review and scope/evidence checks are essential.
A one-action launch could be mistaken for unlimited permission to publish, provision, spend, attack systems or bypass authorization; privileged actions must still need explicit grants.
Chat-only role switching is not authenticated multi-agent execution, unattended background processing or a global cross-session lock; actual host capabilities must be verified.
Automatic replanning can loop or inflate cost; enforce one active specialist, task budgets, dependency validation, explicit stop conditions and traceable change approvals.
synergy_note: Builds on IDEA-000001 routing, IDEA-000002 directory, IDEA-000006 handoffs, IDEA-000009 OPS Director, IDEA-000017 bounded single lane, IDEA-000018 tool/permission checks, IDEA-000019 release gate, IDEA-000027 budgets and IDEA-000034 playbooks. Distinct new value: user-facing plan generation, readable team-staffed task graph and an authorized 'Work on this' launch; never a 13th skill or mandatory library dependency.

evidence.claim: The existing v0.0.2 release plan describes manually composed milestones, conditional team allocation, Head-controlled one-worker routing and verification gates. It does not establish an implemented user-facing one-action mission launcher.

source_status_text: 2026-10-30 owner requested this new idea be elaborated and captured while v0.0.2 was at M5. Captured design direction only; not approved for implementation or v0.0.2 release.
